blocks.html:
Delete Section 2.2.4 and replace as follows:
2.2.4 Carrying channels shall be designed to support the suspended loads, and shall be a minimum 1 1/2" deep (38 mm) cold-rolled steel channel weighing 0.440 pounds per linear foot (0.681 kg/m) and shall be given an electro-galvanized, hot-dipped galvanized cadmium coating, or zinc coating.
